selectionEntries.comment: REV10 CONFIGURATION: automatically present in every roster. The player chooses Not Included (default) or Included. Included exposes the Great Traitors' Arsenal units. If the player switches back to Not Included while an Arsenal unit is already selected, that unit remains visible and reports a constructive error until removed or the Arsenal is set back to Included.

selectionEntries.name: Additional Copy Costs

modifiers.value: Additional Copy Costs is automatically managed by the listbuilder and should appear only once. Remove any extra Additional Copy Costs entries.

selectionEntries.comment:
ADDITIONAL COPY COSTS REV6 / GS17. Permanent required accounting entry. The single parent now exposes Troops and Other accounting children. Troops use the 4 / 6 / 8 normal-copy allowance and Other preserves the existing 1 / 2 / 3 arithmetic. Fresh Initiates is a semantic exemption: the Khorne Berzerkers unit attached to Butcher Surgeon adds 0 Points to the Army List and therefore does not consume a Troop normal-copy allowance. Because Butcher Surgeon is Rare and limited to one, the Troops ledger refunds one +20 surcharge whenever that association exists and the raw Berzerker count has crossed the active threshold. The parent retains automatic insertion, Required Additional Copy Costs Configuration, and duplicate-entry validation.
GREAT TRAITORS' ARSENAL REV7: the host Additional Copy Costs entry remains the only accounting entry. Imported Arsenal units are charged here rather than bringing a second CSM configuration entry into the roster.

selectionEntries.name: Troops
selectionEntries.comment:
TROOP COPY-COST LEDGER. Khorne Berzerkers and Jakhals use the GS17 4 / 6 / 8 normal-copy allowance. Fresh Initiates exempts the one Khorne Berzerkers unit actually attached to the Rare Butcher Surgeon from the effective copy count; the exemption is compiled as a single -20 refund whenever that association exists and the raw Berzerker count has crossed the active surcharge threshold.
GREAT TRAITORS' ARSENAL REV7: also accounts for imported Cultists and the Legionaries family using the same 4 / 6 / 8 GS17 thresholds. Replenished Ranks retains the CSM one-copy Chaos Apothecary exemption.

selectionEntries.name: Other
selectionEntries.comment:
OTHER COPY-COST LEDGER. Contains the catalogue's pre-existing +20 Points soft-copy-cost arithmetic for Red Butchers and Eightbound unchanged, using the 1 / 2 / 3 allowance.
GREAT TRAITORS' ARSENAL REV7: also accounts for the 20 imported generic non-Rare CSM Other families using the normal 1 / 2 / 3 thresholds. All 42 mode-aware Daemonkin refund modifiers are preserved so Master of Possession continues to exempt Possessed or Warp Talons as appropriate.

catalogue.comment:
PHASE 0.1 WORLD EATERS. Great Traitors’ Arsenal is implemented as an opt-in Configuration selection, unchecked by default. The external Chaos Space Marine Arsenal library is intentionally NOT represented by an unresolved catalogueLink in this file. When that reusable library is generated, add a catalogueLink with importRootEntries=false, then add World Eaters-local entryLinks for Arsenal units whose hidden state is controlled by the Great Traitors’ Arsenal configuration selection. Imported units should retain their normal Leader/Troop/Other categories and list-building constraints.
Fresh Initiates is mechanically implemented for the current Khorne Berzerkers base Points cost. Future paid wargear/configuration descendants on that attached host must also be set to 0 under the same Butcher Surgeon association condition.

COMPLETE LOADOUT + VARIABLE SIZE + ADDITIONAL COPY COST PASS
World Eaters now use Game System revision 11. Great Traitors’ Arsenal remains a placeholder. Chaos Lord Lightning Claws use the two-single-claw shorthand. Khorne Berzerkers and Jakhals use canonical specialist model identities. Red Butchers and Eightbound use optional third-model sizing. Eightbound Heavy Chain Glaive appears on every model and disappears from the others once selected. Fresh Initiates zeros both the Berzerker root cost and Icon of Khorne. All native non-Rare Other units use Additional Copy Costs.

CONSTRUCTIVE ERROR UX PASS
Mandatory Leader attachments, host attachment capacity, Rare limits, and Additional Copy Costs configuration safeguards now use the standardized constructive-error patterns. Great Traitors’ Arsenal remains a Phase 0.1 placeholder pending the reusable Chaos Space Marine Arsenal library. Glorious Jump Pack retains a temporary player-facing error because its required Raptors host is not yet available.

REV4 NEW RECRUIT EXPORT COMPATIBILITY
Updated to Warhammer 40k Reforged Game System revision 12. All Points cost references now use New Recruit's canonical Warhammer 40,000 cost-type identifier 51b2-306e-1021-d207. No unit costs, loadouts, validation, Leader attachment behavior, Great Traitors’ Arsenal placeholder, Glorious Jump Pack placeholder logic, Rare limits, categories, or Additional Copy Costs arithmetic were otherwise changed.

REV5 RETROSPECTIVE POLISH PASS
Revisited World Eaters against the presentation standards established by the completed cross-faction Polish Pass. Added explicit model headers to World Eaters Terminator Chaos Lord, World Eaters Juggernaut Chaos Lord, World Eaters Chaos Lord, Butcher Surgeon, Sage of Slaughter, Slaughterbound, and Khârne, the Betrayer. Standardized the Terminator Chaos Lord ranged packages to 2x count style and meaningful-choice-first '&' grammar. Split the fixed multi-weapon packages on Berzerker Champion, Berzerker 2, Berzerkers 3-5, and Jakhal Dishonoured into separate visible weapon lines while preserving existing package IDs for the first component. Renamed Red Butchers and Eightbound Additional Models to Additional Model. Moved Exalted Eightbound from Paid Wargear into Unit Upgrade. Standardized the Butcher Surgeon and Khârne Rare errors plus Khorne Berzerkers and Eightbound host-limit errors. Great Traitors’ Arsenal, the incomplete Chaos Space Marine host ecosystem, Glorious Jump Pack/Raptors placeholder behavior, Lightning Claw shorthand, Fresh Initiates mechanics, points, categories, associations, Additional Copy Costs, and all other rules semantics remain unchanged.

REV6 / GS17 TROOP COPY COSTS
Updated to Game System revision 17 and adopted the unified Additional Copy Costs presentation with Troops and Other child ledgers. Khorne Berzerkers and Jakhals now use the Troop 4 / 6 / 8 normal-copy allowance; each further identical copy costs +20 Points. Red Butchers and Eightbound retain their previous Other 1 / 2 / 3 arithmetic unchanged. FRESH INITIATES EXCEPTION: the Khorne Berzerkers unit actually attached to the Rare Butcher Surgeon adds 0 Points to the Army List and is excluded from the effective Troop copy count. This is implemented centrally as one +20 refund at the relevant threshold while the Butcher Surgeon association exists. All unrelated unit rules, loadouts, attachments, Rare behavior, and Arsenal placeholders are unchanged.

REV7 — GREAT TRAITORS' ARSENAL PILOT
Implemented the reusable Great Traitors' Arsenal architecture against the new Chaos Space Marines 3.3.5 Arsenal Library V1. The existing opt-in Configuration selection now exposes 28 portable generic CSM units under the dedicated visible Great Traitors’ Arsenal category, leaving native World Eaters Leader / Troop / Other sections at the top. Arsenal choices remain hidden while the switch is off unless already selected, in which case they stay visible and report a constructive error. The host Additional Copy Costs entry now accounts for imported CSM Troops and Other units, including Replenished Ranks and all existing mode-aware Daemonkin refunds. World Eaters Chaos Lord can now attach to imported Legionaries, Cultists, and Chosen; Glorious Jump Pack is fully implemented and instead attaches to imported Raptors. No native World Eaters IDs were regenerated. Existing Fresh Initiates, native copy-cost arithmetic, loadouts, Rare semantics, and unrelated rules remain unchanged.

REV8 — JAKHAL LOADOUT / EXPORT FIX
Collapsed the Jakhal Dishonoured's mandatory Skullsmasher Mace and Chainblade into one atomic Skullsmasher Mace & Chainblade final-state option. Replaced the baked-name '8x Jakhal Chainblades' upgrade with a canonical shared Jakhal Chainblades object selected at a genuine quantity of 8. Existing live IDs are preserved where the player decision survives; the superseded standalone Dishonoured Chainblade object remains as an inert legacy shell.

REV9 — KHORNE BERZERKER LOADOUT CLEANUP
Collapsed the Champion and Berzerker 2 mandatory weapon pairs into atomic final-state loadouts. Renamed Berzerkers 3-5 to Berzerker 3-5 and replaced its separate weapon lines with one atomic Berserker Chainblade & Bolt Pistol package. The shared target is canonically named 3x Berserker Chainblade & Bolt Pistol so New Recruit exports the correct three-model quantity while the editor keeps the concise label. Superseded standalone weapon entries remain as inert legacy shells.

REV10 — GREAT TRAITORS' ARSENAL CONFIGURATION FIX
Great Traitors’ Arsenal is now automatically added under Configuration and contains one mandatory state choice: Not Included (default) or Included. Arsenal unit links are hidden while Not Included unless already selected; Included exposes them. Existing selected Arsenal units remain visible and receive a constructive error if the configuration is switched back to Not Included. The Arsenal library, unit IDs, points, categories, attachments, and all imported-unit mechanics are otherwise unchanged.

REV11 — GS20 TROOP RULE + JAKHAL FIXED PACKAGE
Updated to Game System revision 20 and retargeted Khorne Berzerkers and Jakhals to the Additional Copy Cost - Troop short-form rule. Jakhals 3-10 now use one mandatory literal 8x Jakhal Chainblades package instead of the previous quantity-eight implementation. The surviving player-facing selection ID, Great Traitors’ Arsenal configuration, points, categories, and unrelated mechanics are unchanged.
